logline: Takeo Goda - a giant, intimidating high schooler every girl overlooks - falls for a soft-spoken pastry lover who sees exactly what everyone else missed, launching anime's most wholesome romance.

renewal.note: 24-episode single-season run concluded September 23, 2015. Adapted the complete manga run (13 volumes, 2011-2016). A live-action film was released October 31, 2015.

bollymeter.basis: Won the Kodansha Manga Award and Shogakukan Award in the shojo category; the anime earned enthusiastic reception for its subversion of romance tropes through Takeo's lovable sincerity. Consistently cited as comfort-watch anime that avoids genre cliches.

seasons.review_body: Madhouse adapted Kazune Kawahara and Aruko's award-winning shojo manga into 24 episodes for the spring 2015 Nippon TV season, simulcast globally by Crunchyroll. The premise inverts every standard romantic lead template: Takeo Goda is built like a professional wrestler, adored by men for his heroic instincts, invisible to girls who immediately redirect their interest to his conventionally handsome best friend. The show's emotional intelligence lies in never treating Takeo as a joke - his straightforwardness and physical courage are genuine virtues, not quirks to overcome. The unusually healthy central relationship is the show's structural anchor; once the pairing is established, drama comes from external complications rather than manufactured misunderstandings. The manga won the 37th Kodansha Award (shojo, 2013) and 61st Shogakukan Award (shojo, 2016), and Da Vinci magazine ranked it the number one female-oriented comic of early 2013. A rare genre entry that earns its warmth.

episode_reviews.title: My Story Begins
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: A premiere that earns immediate affection by making Takeo's defining qualities - physical power, moral clarity, total lack of self-pity - land as genuinely appealing rather than played for laughs.
episode_reviews.the_moment: Takeo rescuing Yamato from the train groper and her response to it - directed at him, not his handsome friend - resets the premise of every romance anime that preceded it.
